title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training
description: Encoder-decoder trained with denoising (text infilling, sentence permutation). Best model for generation tasks at release — summarization, translation, QA. Combines BERT's understanding with GPT's generation.
authors: Lewis, Liu, Goyal, Ghazvininejad, Mohamed, Levy, Stoyanov, Zettlemoyer
